diagnostics.note: Signal = 1 - Brier/Brier(climatology). Positive => better than always predicting the base rate. The market block is the de-vigged closing moneyline over the same seasons where both exist.

marketReferenceNote: De-vigged closing prices from the archive; these are NOT official NFL values and no league source publishes prices.
notes: Every ROI figure is reported next to its week-block bootstrap interval. A point estimate without an interval is not published.
The luck test compares the strategy with a null in which the true probability of each bet is the de-vigged closing market probability. p = P(no-information bettor earns at least this ROI).
A pooled break-even win rate is deliberately NOT used as a significance test: with mixed prices a win-count test and a profit test disagree, and the profit is what matters.
No strategy is reward-eligible. Reward eligibility requires gates G7 (frozen prospective trial) and G8 (human release review), neither of which this lab can self-certify.
Player props and same-game parlays are declared but BLOCKED because the archive contains no prop prices.
